title: Is Hunyuan 3D worth the trouble?
author: Crystallover1991
selftext:
I saw someone mention Hunyuan 3D in our Discord chat. After some investigation, I learned that it is simply an open-weight model that creates 3D objects via either images or text. The process involves the user running their own instance of Hunyuan 3D or calling it from another application, as well as not being user-friendly enough to offer a print function.

Meanwhile, I needed to convert a client's drawing into a 3D format before the end of the day. In my case, it was faster to use a GLB based browser workspace such as Tripo AI, because it required no initial setup, use of any models, or hosting.

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body:
You sure they weren't talking about HY 3D Global? Which gives X number of free gens per day and is of a much higher quality than their local, open weights offering?

That's not to say that you can't set up Hunyuan 2.5, but there is a dramatic difference in quality where I'd say it's absolutely not worth taking the time to set it up. Pixal is the only local gen that's going to give anything remotely resembling a quality model. And even then I just use them as references and manually rebuild from primitives and wrap/clean-up when using models genned that way. It's not like Tripo where you can just make adjustments and fix some issues and have a workable production ready mesh.
